judged_text: The non-standard-port branch of absolutize_urls (prefix << ":#{uri.port}" unless port is 80/443) is never triggered by any test — topic_embed_spec only imports http://eviltrout.com/123, whose URI port is 80. adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls`, the prefix includes a non-standard port via `prefix << ":#{uri.port}" if uri.port != 80 && uri.port != 443`. The added spec (`spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb`) only uses `url = 'http://eviltrout.com/123'`, which implies port 80, so the non-standard-port branch is not exercised by any test in this diff. This is a concrete coverage gap for newly added edge-case logic (not a currently verifiable defect).
